root_cause: Recent deployment changed the memory limit from 1Gi to 512Mi, causing payment-service pods to exceed their configured memory limit and terminate with exit code 137 (OOMKilled).
contributing_factors: Memory limit reduced from 1Gi to 512Mi in deployment configuration
Application memory usage (495Mi) exceeded new limit (512Mi) under load
No canary deployment to catch memory issue before full rollout
Memory request also reduced from 512Mi to 256Mi, affecting QoS class
evidence: Deployment occurred at 2024-01-15T10:28:00Z (2 minutes before incident)
Stack trace shows java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space
Error rate 38.5% correlates with pod crashes
No traffic spike observed (latency P99 320ms, not extreme)

remediation.recommendation: Restore previous memory limit (1Gi) and redeploy with canary rollout
steps: Revert memory limit change in deployment config (512Mi -> 1Gi)
Deploy to canary (10% traffic) and monitor memory usage
Gradually increase traffic to 100% over 30 minutes
